name: Pushouse
description: WhatsApp automation + e-commerce tools — broadcasts, carts, engagement for merchants who live in WhatsApp (UAE-founded, MENA/global e-com vibe).

mentions.evidence: ~$25.9k MRR, 248 active subscriptions, ~$34.2k L30, ~$278k all-time, ~1,500 users claimed, founded Jan 2026, UAE. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Country/channel messaging ops for e-com (WhatsApp, SMS, iMessage) beats another generic email ESP — especially where WhatsApp is default.

whyItPrints: In many markets WhatsApp is the CRM. Pushouse sells channel ops, not a new social network — high L30 vs young founding date suggests merchants already paying for delivery infra.
